The mounting-stress statement this row needs is Note 5 of the datasheet itself, verbatim: 'Due to the sensitivity of the MPXV4006, external mechanical stresses and mounting position can affect the zero pressure output reading. That confirms the TcOffset double-counting argument above and adds a requirement nobody had written down: THE AUTOZERO MUST BE RE-TAKEN AS THE SEALED BODY WARMS, or the 2.46% does not hold

description: Series protection on the breath buffer output into the umbilical
notes: TWO, not one, and 1206 not 0805 - both changed with the schematic and this row did not follow. R1 in the BREATH leg, R1b its twin in the AGND leg: the return leg carries no signal current, so a matching resistor costs no differential gain and is what keeps the 1M bias pair from capping CMRR at 60dB on its own. 1206 because ADR 0003's designed-safe sustained +12V fault puts 11.8mA through R1: 139mW against an 0805's ~125mW. description: ESD protection on the BREATH and AGND legs
notes: 12V STANDOFF, NOT 5V. BREATH's normal top of range is 4.7V against a 5V array's V_RWM - 300mV of margin on the project's DC-accurate output, with 1.5uA of leakage into a 1k output resistor.
